description: This file defines a private, final class ErrorOutcome implementing the MappingOutcome interface. The class encapsulates error information related to message mapping, including a mapper ID, an exception, and optional topic path and external message details. It provides an accept method for visitor pattern integration.

classes.name: ErrorOutcome
classes.description: A final class representing an error outcome during message mapping, containing error details and optional context information.

methods.name: <constructor>
methods.description: Initializes an ErrorOutcome instance with specified mapper ID, error, and optional topic path and external message.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing the Visitor interface and delegates error handling to the visitor's onError method.
